name: llm-lab
description: Model-level evaluation of local Ollama models with promptfoo

scripts.eval: sh -c 'f=results/runs/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).json; mkdir -p results/runs; PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=results/promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 promptfoo eval --no-table -o $f "$@"; s=$?; [ -f $f ] && exec .venv/bin/python helpers/summary.py $f; exit $s' eval
